test_title: PYST 17: SSC MTS - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 12 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Ishita can read a newspaper in 'n' minutes. What part of the newspaper can she read in 7 minutes? (n > 7)
solution:
**Given:**

Ishita can read a newspaper in 'n' minutes.

**Calculation:**

Ishita can read a newspaper in 'n' minutes

Ishita can read 1/nth part of a newspaper in 1 minute.

Ishita can read 7/nth part of a newspaper in 7 minutes.

**∴ The required answer is (7)/(n).**
